title: redirect() in a Server Action does nothing, or logs NEXT_REDIRECT, when it sits inside try/catch
symptoms: The action finishes but the browser stays on the same page
The catch block reports a failure for a request that succeeded
cause: redirect(), permanentRedirect() and notFound() work by throwing a special error that the framework catches higher up. A surrounding try/catch intercepts it first, so the navigation never happens.
fix: Call redirect() after the try/catch block, or rethrow framework errors at the top of the catch with unstable_rethrow.
affected: Next.js App Router 13.4 to 16.4, Server Actions, Route Handlers and Server Components
